text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} and the others who were assigned the job by Tsumugi have arrived at the forest at night.
text_block_list.orig_text:
引き受けた仕事をツムギから割り振られた{0}たちは、
夜の森へとやってきていた。

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I wonder if we can do it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ……
オイラたちにできるかな……

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: I'm worried even before doing it. I can do it, I can do it. So, what kind of job should we do?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やる前から心配してどうすんだよ。
できるできる。
で、
オレたちは
何の仕事をすりゃあいいんだ？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you hear me? 
I thought it was strange because you seemed unusually confident, so I was suspicious, you know? But now I understand.
text_block_list.orig_text:
聞いてなかったんスか？
妙に自信満々だからおかしいと思ってたんスけど、
納得ッス。

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: You said you wanted to slay monsters, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物退治
って、
言ってた……
よね？

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Ha?! Us, fighting monsters?! That's definitely impossible! Alright, let's go back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ！？　
オレたちで魔物退治！？
そんなの無理に決まってるじゃねぇか！　
よし
帰ろう！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Don't do it, pal! Tsumugi told me to!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダメッスよ！　
ツムギさんに言われたんスから！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: But hey! There's no way we can defeat monsters!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもよー！　
オレたちが魔物を倒せるわけねぇじゃねぇか！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: How rude! I am, after all, a member of [NIGHTMARE]!
text_block_list.orig_text:
失礼ッスね！　
自分はこれでも
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】なんスよ！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Ah, come to think of it, I remember you saying something like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
そういやそんなこと言ってたな。

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Are you strong, Matsuri?
text_block_list.orig_text:
マツリちゃんって、
強いの？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
I can't say if I'm strong or not, but 
I do want to protect the weak!
text_block_list.orig_text:
強いかは分からないッスけど、
弱い人を守りたいとは思ってるッス！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text:
Then please protect us too! 
Even though we're not human, we're weak!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあオレたちのことも守ってくれ！
人じゃないけど弱いぞ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: This time, the monsters aren't that strong, so it'll be okay, Miss Rei. It's no different from hunting wild rabbits.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今回の魔物はそんな強くないやつッスから、
大丈夫ッスよ。
野兎狩るのと変わらないッス。

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: B-But...
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
でも……

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Um, well... I do want to, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そりゃあ……
なりてぇけどよ……

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Ah, even I...
text_block_list.orig_text:
オ、
オイラも……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: And Tsumugi wouldn't do something like this without any thought! If you can handle this job, it should open up the path to becoming a full-fledged person!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに
ツムギさんがなんの考えもなく
こんなことさせるワケないッス！
この仕事をこなせば
一人前への道も開けるはずッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I can...?
text_block_list.orig_text: なれるかな……？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: You can, pal! Facing monsters will build your courage!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なれるッス！　
魔物と戦えば
度胸もつくッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, I'll do my best...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なら、
がんばる……！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text:
If Victor is going to do it, then I'll do it too. 
I don't want to be thought of as scared.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ビクターがやるってんなら
オレもやるよ。
ビビったって思われたくねぇし。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: That settles it, pal! Let's do this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで決まりッスね！　
やるッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Here it is again! Haaaaa!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
また出たッスね！　
はぁぁああああ！！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Wow! Matsuri is so strong!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すげぇ！　
マツリってつえぇんだな！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Matsuri, you're so cool...
text_block_list.orig_text:
マツリちゃん、
かっこいい……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Both of you, stop watching and start fighting, please.
text_block_list.orig_text: 二人とも見てないで戦ってほしいッス。

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Because Matsuri can handle it on her own, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって、
マツリ一人でどうにかできてるじゃん。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Well, then there's no point in taking this job... 
I know! Let's try to do it together next time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃ
この仕事を受けた意味がないッス……
そうだ！　
次は二人で何とかしてみるッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Eddie has a spear, and Victor has fangs and claws, you know!
text_block_list.orig_text:
エディさんには槍が、
ビクターさんには
牙と爪があるんスから！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Eh-eeeeeee...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
えぇぇぇぇ……！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Don't say 'Eeeeee', pal. It's a challenge!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇ、
じゃないッス。
何事も挑戦ッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Hmm, but from what I can see, it doesn't seem that scary, so maybe we'll be fine. Let's give it a try, Victor.
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー
でも見てる限りそんなに怖くなさそうだし、
なんとかなるんじゃねぇか？　
やってみようぜ、
ビクター

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: U-um... I'll... give it a try...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うん……
やって、
みる……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: You've finally come! Let's go, Victor!
text_block_list.orig_text:
来やがったな！　
いくぞ、
ビクター！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うん……

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Bring it on from anywhere! I'll turn you into rust on my spear!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どっからでも掛かってきやがれ！　
槍のサビにしてやるぜ！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: But, I'll do my best...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
が、
がんばるぞ……！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit, pal!
text_block_list.orig_text: その意気ッス！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Victor & Eddie
text_block_list.text: EEK!?
text_block_list.orig_text: ひっ！？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Victor & Eddie
text_block_list.text: Run away~!!
text_block_list.orig_text: にげろ～！！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Ah, darn! Guess I don't have a choice! Teeyaaaaah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーもう！　
仕方ないッスね！　
ていやぁぁあああ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: I'm saved...
text_block_list.orig_text: 助かった……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Glad you two are safe. Next time,
you both need to stand up and face it head on!
text_block_list.orig_text:
助かったじゃないッス。
二人とも、
ちゃんと立ち向かわないとダメッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: You can't help but feel scared. Since both of us are fighting against monsters for the first time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
怖いのは仕方ないッス。
二人とも
魔物と戦うのは初めてなんスから。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
But both of you want to be the ones who scare, right?
Running away will only make your goals further away.
Is that okay with you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも二人は
怖がらせる側になりたいんスよね？
逃げてたら
目標はどんどん遠ざかるッス。
それでもいいんスか？

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: I-I don't want to! I want to be scared!
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やだよ！　
オイラ、
怖くなりたい……！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, then let's give it another try, okay? 
Don't worry. I've got your back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなら、
もう一回挑戦してみるッスよ。
大丈夫。
自分たちがついてるッス！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Ah, ah! I-I-I'll give it a try!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ああ！　
や、
やややってみるぜ！

text_block_list.name: ビクター
text_block_list.text:
がが
がんばる！
text_block_list.orig_text:
がが
がんばる！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: ...I want to appreciate your enthusiasm, but if we continue like this, it seems like we'll end up in the same situation again. I need to come up with a way that suits both of you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……意気込みは
買いたいッスけど、
このままやっても
また
同じことになりそうッスね。
二人に合ったやり方を考えてあげないと……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Oh! So this is a binding technique! I think it's great!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おぉ！　
からめ手ってやつッスね！　
いいと思うッス！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Is it that easy to set up a trap like that?
text_block_list.orig_text: そんな都合よく落とせるかぁ？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it depends on the method, but...
Personally, I've never used a pitfall before...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
やり方次第とは思うッスけど……
自分、
落とし穴は
使ったことないッスし……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
{0}, do you have any experience? 
Have you made one many times? ...Does that come in handy?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さん、経験あるんスか？
何度も落ちたことがある？　
……それは
役に
立つんスかね？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
But, it's better than doing nothing! 
For now, let's try digging a pitfall!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
何もやらないよりはマシッスね！
とりあえず
落とし穴を掘ってみるッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
For now, I tried digging, but what should I do next? 
I don't have anything that would be food for monsters, so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
とりあえず掘ってみたッスけど、
このあとは
どうすればいいんスかね？
魔物の餌になるようなものは持ってないし、
あとは……

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: W-Why are you looking at us?
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんでオイラたちを
見るの？

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: ...Hah! Y-You don't mean to use us as bait, do you!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はっ！　
ま、
まさかオレたちを囮にしようってのか！？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: I-I don't think so, pal. I was just thinking about how you two are the ones the monsters are going to chase after.
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やだなー
そんなこと思ってないッスよー
ただ、
さっきから魔物が追いかけるのは
お二人だなー
って思ってただけッスー

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Are you thinking that?! There's no way I would...
text_block_list.orig_text:
思ってるんじゃねぇか！！　
そんなのオレは絶対に……

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll do it...! 
I've been running away all this time, 
If it's just running away, I can do it... I'm sure... probably...
text_block_list.orig_text:
オ、
オイラ、
やるよ……！
オイラ、
さっきから逃げてばっかりだし、
逃げるだけなら、
できる……
はず……
きっと……
たぶん……

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Hm? Yes, that's right. The things we have to do haven't changed. Alright, let's give it a try!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
確かにそうだな。
やることは変わんねぇや。
よし、
やってみるか！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's get started with the pitfall strategy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあさっそく、
落とし穴作戦始めッス！

text_block_list.name: Victor & Eddie
text_block_list.text: Ohhh!!
text_block_list.orig_text: おー！！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Here it comes! Victor, make sure you run towards the pitfall!
text_block_list.orig_text:
出たぞ！　
ビクター、
きちんと落とし穴の方に逃げるんだからな！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Well, I understand...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
分かった……！！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the monsters have chased after the two of them! 
Now, all we have to do is lead them into the trap!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
魔物は二人を追っていったッスね！
あとは落とし穴に誘導するだけッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Victor & Eddie
text_block_list.text: Ah! It's still scary after all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぎゃー！　
やっぱり怖いー！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Ah! You two! That's not it! Eddie, look in front of you! You'll hit a tree if you continue like that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
二人とも！　
そっちは違うッスよ！
エディさん前見て！　
そのままじゃ木にぶつかるッス！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, ah! You can't just suddenly stop like that!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へ？　
あっ、
あぁぁっ！？　
急には止まれねぇよーー！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Ouchouchouchouch...
text_block_list.orig_text: いてててて……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: U-Uwaaaah!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うわーーー！！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Thats enough! Don't you dare lay a hand on Eddie!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
このー！　
エディに手を、
出すなー！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: GUOOOOOOH
text_block_list.orig_text: グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Was that... Victor's voice just now?
Amazing... He drove away the monsters...
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
今の
ビクターさんの声ッスか？
すごい……
魔物を追い払ったッス……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: While he was at it, he made some of them fall into a pitfall as well...
text_block_list.orig_text: ついでに落とし穴に落ちたッス……

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Alright! This time, I'll turn it into the rust on my spear!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし！　
今度こそ槍のサビにしてやるー！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: ...We took them down, pal.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……倒しちゃったッス。

text_block_list.name: Victor & Eddie
text_block_list.text: Hooray!!
text_block_list.orig_text: やったー！！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Victor, I didn't know you could make such a voice!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ビクター、
おまえあんな声出せるんだな！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text:
I remembered when Tsumugi told me to bark... 
So I tried it, and I did it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ツムギちゃんが吠えろって言ってたの思い出して……
やってみたら、
できた……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: That was amazing, pal! I was scared too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごかったッスよ！　
自分もビビったッス！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Eh, hehehe...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
えへへ……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
This completes the job in a true sense! 
Both of you, well done!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで本当の意味で仕事完了ッスね！
二人とも、
よくやったッス！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: At the same time that Matsuri and the others were struggling with defeating monsters, Tsumugi had arrived at the graveyard.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マツリたちが魔物退治に苦労しているのと同時刻。
ツムギたちは墓地にやってきていた。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey Tsumugi. What kind of job did we take on? 
You said you would tell me later, so I followed you silently.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ね、
ねぇツムギ。
私たちは
何の仕事を引き受けたんだ？
あとで教えるっていうから、
黙ってついてきたけど。

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Miss Rei? Are you scared of graves?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだよレイさま、
お墓が怖いのか？

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: If you're scared, why don't you come closer to me? It's bright, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
怖いならボクの近くに来なよ。
明るいよ？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: I appreciate the sentiment, but, um, I'll pass on that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
気持ちはありがたいけど、
その、
遠慮しておくよ。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Quietly. It seems that prey has arrived.
text_block_list.orig_text:
静かに。
獲物が来たみたいですよ。

text_block_list.name: Matthew & Hughes
text_block_list.text: What is this...?
text_block_list.orig_text: えもの……？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: What kind of job did you take on...
text_block_list.orig_text: いったいどんな仕事を受けたんだ……

text_block_list.name: Punk 1
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Do you think I can commit evil deeds because I'm scared of ghosts! Hey, I'm going to take one of these tombstones home!
text_block_list.orig_text:
がははは！　
お化けが怖くて
悪事が働けるかってんだ！
おい、
墓石の一つでも持って帰るぞ！

text_block_list.name: Punk 2
text_block_list.text: Hey, boss! You're drinking too much! If you do that, you'll be punished! Let's go home!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
ちょっと親分！　
呑み過ぎですって！
そんなことしたら罰があたりやす！　
帰りやしょうぜ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Yes, so our job is to drive away those insolent people who came here for a test of courage.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
というわけで私たちの仕事は
あのように肝試しに来た不埒な輩を追い払うことです。

text_block_list.name: Matthew & Hughes
text_block_list.text: I see-
text_block_list.orig_text: なるほどー

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
What, is that really okay? 
If that's the case, then I'll go. Leave it to me in situations like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだ、
そんなことでいいんだね。
それなら私が行ってくるよ。
こういうことなら任せてくれ。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Hey Miss Rei! What are you trying to do so casually! You're scaring me! You should try to drive away ghosts like a proper ghost!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとレイ様！　
何普通にやろうとしてるんですか！
怖がらせるんですよ！　
お化けらしく追い払うんです！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Huh? B-But...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
け、
けど……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: What is the purpose of this job? It's practice for a haunted house, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
何のための仕事ですか。
お化け屋敷の練習ですよ？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: First, let me show you an example.
text_block_list.orig_text: まずは私がお手本を見せますね。

text_block_list.name: Punk 2
text_block_list.text: Oh, let's stop... I'm just a grandma's boy, so this kind of thing is really no good for me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やめましょうよ……
俺、
おばあちゃんっこだから
こういうのほんとダメなんすよ！

text_block_list.name: Punk 1
text_block_list.text: Don't be discouraged. What can someone who's already given up do anyway? Just watch, even this kind of tombstone...
text_block_list.orig_text:
んだよ、
しらけるな。
だいたいおっちんじまったやつに何ができるってんだ。
見てろよ、
こんな墓石なんか……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Please do not move.
text_block_list.orig_text: 動かないでください。

text_block_list.name: Punk 1
text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.orig_text: んだぁ？

text_block_list.name: Punk 2
text_block_list.text: Eeek!?
text_block_list.orig_text: ひぃっ！？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: If you dare disturb my slumber by touching that gravestone, then you shall be condemned to eternal rest as well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その墓石に触れ、
私の眠りを妨げようと言うなら、
永遠の眠りについてもらうことになりますよ？

text_block_list.name: Punk 1
text_block_list.text:
What? A very beautiful girl has appeared! 
With this, even if she's a ghost...
text_block_list.orig_text:
んだぁ？　
えらくベッピンなねぇちゃんが出てきたじゃねぇか！
これなら幽霊でも悪く……

text_block_list.name: Punk 2
text_block_list.text: Oh, boss! A weapon is being held against my neck!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
親分！　
首！　
首に
武器突き付けられてるっすよ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Your blood looks delicious...
It's just perfect as food for bats.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたの血はまずそうですが……
コウモリたちの餌にはちょうどいいですね。

text_block_list.name: Punk 1
text_block_list.text: W-What the hell are you saying!
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
いったい何を言ってやがる！

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Are you okay, Tsumugi?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ツムギちゃん
だいじょうぶー？

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: We'll help out too, Miss Rei!
text_block_list.orig_text: オレサマたちも手伝うぜー！

text_block_list.name: ツムギ
text_block_list.text:
あっ、
ちょっと！　
出てこないでくださいよ！
雰囲気ぶち壊しじゃないですか！
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
ちょっと！　
出てこないでくださいよ！
雰囲気ぶち壊しじゃないですか！

text_block_list.name: Punk 2
text_block_list.text: And, here I come!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
出たーーーー！！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
...It seems like they ran away. 
In that case, let's take advantage of this momentum and drive them away.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なんか逃げてくれましたね。
それならこの勢いを利用して
追い払っちゃいましょう。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, your companion has escaped, huh? 
In that case, just you alone...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーあ、
お仲間さん逃げちゃいましたね。
それじゃあ、
あなただけでも……

text_block_list.name: Punk 1
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait a minute! I-I'm sorry! I promise, I promise I won't do something like this again~~~~~~!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
ちょ
ちょっと待て！　
わ、
悪かった！
二度と、
二度とこんなことしないから～～～～～～！！

text_block_list.name: Punk 1
text_block_list.text: Actually, I'm also a grandma's boy~~~!
text_block_list.orig_text: 実は俺もおばあちゃんっこなんだよ～～～！

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Ah! A scream! Let's eat, Hughes! *chomp*
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ！　
悲鳴だ！　
食べよう、ヒューズ！　
はむっ！

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: Amph!
text_block_list.orig_text: あむ！

text_block_list.name: Matthew & Hughes
text_block_list.text: *Chomp chomp chomp*...
text_block_list.orig_text: もぐもぐもぐ……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: They eat screams like that, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
悲鳴って
あんな風に食べるんですね。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: It looks like they're eating mist. It certainly doesn't seem like it would harm anyone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
霞を食んでるようにしか見えないね。
確かに、
あれなら人に危害は及ばなさそうだ。

text_block_list.name: Matthew & Hughes
text_block_list.text: Delicious~~~!
text_block_list.orig_text: おいし～～～！

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Wow, I never knew screams could be this delicious!
text_block_list.orig_text:
悲鳴って
こんなにおいしいんだね！

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: I have to show off to Eddie and the others!
text_block_list.orig_text:
エディたちに
自慢してやらないと！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: I don't really get it, but I'm glad it was good.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よく分かりませんけど、
おいしかったならよかったです。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
Wow! We can even eat screams! 
This is all thanks to Tsumugi and the others!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい！　
ボクたちでも悲鳴を食べられるなんて！
これもツムギちゃんたちのおかげだよ！

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: Thank you!
text_block_list.orig_text: ありがとな！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: You're welcome...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どう、
いたしまして……？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: It was a success that was different from what was expected, but well, let's just accept it. Now! It's Miss Rei's turn next. Please drive them away quickly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
想定とは違う成功でしたが、
まぁよしとしましょう。
さぁ！　
次はレイ様の番ですよ。
ばっちり追い払っちゃってください。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
You're really going to do it, huh... 
Well, at first, I didn't know what to do, but 
I'll threaten them with my weapon too...
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱりやるんだね……
まぁ、
最初はどうやればいいのか分からなかったけど、
私も
武器で脅して……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: You know that's definitely not allowed!
text_block_list.orig_text: そんなのダメに決まってるでしょ！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why? Tsumugi, you were doing it, weren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
どうして？　
ツムギはやっていたじゃないか。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: I am a cruel female vampire, so there is no problem at all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は冷酷な女吸血鬼って設定ですからね。
何の問題もありません。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Tsumugi was really scary!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ツムギちゃん
すっごく怖かったよ！

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: Ghost Father was really scary, you know!
text_block_list.orig_text: ゴーストファーザーなみにおっかなかったぜ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Is that a compliment... Well, it's fine. 
But for now, it's my Miss Rei!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは褒められているんでしょうか……
まぁ、
いいです。
それより今はレイ様ですよ！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
はい。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Miss Rei is a deep-seeded young lady who was betrayed by the man she loved and met a tragic death. I have never held anything heavier than a spoon! Having a weapon is out of the question!
text_block_list.orig_text:
レイ様は愛した男に裏切られ、
非業の死を遂げた深窓の令嬢です。
スプーンより重いものは持ったことがありません！
武器なんてもってのほかです！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: In a ghostly manner, she delicately scares him by murmuring her resentment towards the man who abandoned her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
幽霊らしくはかなげに、
自分を捨てた男への恨みをブツブツと吐いて怖がらせるんです！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Wait a minute, is it just me or is the difficulty level higher?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと待って、
私だけ難易度が高くないか！？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Everything is a challenge!
text_block_list.orig_text: 何事も挑戦ですよ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Just another group of ruffians has arrived! 
Please get ready! We'll be watching from the shadows. 
Come on, both of you, let's go.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょうどまた不埒な輩が来ましたよ！
準備してください！　
私たちは物陰で見守ってますから。
ほら、
二人とも行きますよ。

text_block_list.name: Matthew & Hughes
text_block_list.text: Yes!
text_block_list.orig_text: はーい！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wait, wait a minute! 
You can't just suddenly... go away like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ちょ、
ちょっと！
そんないきなり……
行ってしまった。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Um, let me see... What was Tsumugi saying again? 
Betrayed by the man she loved and met an untimely death? 
There's no way I could understand something like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
えっと……
ツムギはなんて言ってたっけ。
愛する男に裏切られて非業の死を遂げた？
そんなの私に分かるわけがないだろ。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Mostly, when it comes to men, the only one that comes to mind is {0}... There are things to be grateful to him for, but... wait a minute...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だいたい男なんて
{0}くらいしか
思い浮かばない……
彼に感謝することこそあれ、
恨むことなんて……
いや……
待てよ……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
When I think about it, he seems to know a lot of girls... 
Even Tsumugi asked him for help with her tailoring... 
If it was about gathering materials, I could have helped too, you know...
text_block_list.orig_text:
考えてみれば
彼はいろんな女の子と知り合いだな……
ツムギだって仕立て屋の手伝いを頼んでいたし……
素材採集なら
私だって手伝えたじゃないか……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Why just the two of you... I wanted to go together too... 
You always do things like that where I can't see... 
Even me... even I...
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうして二人だけで……
私も一緒に行きたかった……
キミはいつも私の知らないところでそんな風に……
私も……
私だって……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: I wanted to be with you...!!
text_block_list.orig_text: キミと一緒に居たかったぞ……！！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Y-Y-You?! Wh-What are you doing here?!
What is this?! A-Am I hallucinating?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キ、
キキ、
キミ！？　
ど、
どうしてここに！？
な、
なんだこれは！？　
げ、
幻覚！？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Ah, I-I see. It ended surprisingly quickly... Wait, more importantly!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
そ、
そう。
意外と早く終わったんだね……
ってそれより！！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Wh-When did you get there? I-It can't be, you didn't hear what I was saying, right!? Right!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
キ、
キミはいつからそこに？
ま、
まさか
私が言っていたこと
聞いてないよね！？　
ね！？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: So you heard me... No, please don't worry about it. It's nothing. You see, I just thought it would be comforting if you stayed with us, since Tsumugi and the others are apart.
text_block_list.orig_text:
聞こえていたのか……
いや、
気にしないでくれ。
なんでもないんだ。
ほら、
ツムギたちが離れているから
一緒に居てくれたら心強いなと思っていただけだよ。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: There is no other meaning, right? Isn't it good?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それ以外の意味はないからね？　
いいね？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Well, that means you heard it. Um, that's because, um, that's because I'm more suited for monster extermination than this job here, so there's no deep meaning, no deep meaning at all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それは
聞こえていたってことだね。
えっと、
あれはその、
こっちの仕事より魔物退治が
私に向いているからで、
深い意味は、
深い意味はないから！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: A-Anyway, do you want to be with me, too? For you to say something like that... Oh, so you're feeling lonely being alone in a grave? What a coincidence. Me too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
と、
というか
キミも私と一緒に居たいの？
キミがそんなこと言うなんて……
ああ、
お墓で一人が心細いのか。
奇遇だね。
私もだよ。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
However, even so, if we have merged 
it would have been nice if you had called out to me earlier. 
I was so surprised.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしても、
合流したなら
もっと早く声を掛けてくれてもいいじゃないか。
ビックリしてしまったよ。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Oh, um, I was supposed to pretend to be a ghost here and drive away those unruly people who came for a test of courage... or so I thought.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
えっと、
私はここで幽霊の振りをして、
肝試しに来る不埒な輩を追い払う……
はずだったんだ。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
You came here... huh? 
If you're here, then Matsuri and the others...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこにキミが来てしまって……
ん？
キミが居るってことは
マツリたちも……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Hey, Mr. {0}! Don't leave me behind, please!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーい、{0}さーん！
置いてかないでくださいッス！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's good. It seems like Matsuri and the others didn't ask about it. No, it's nothing. Please don't worry about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
よかった。
マツリたちには聞かれなかったみたいだね。
いや、
なんでもないんだ。
気にしないでくれ。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Aren't you Kishi-san? 
Have you already finished over there?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
騎士さんじゃないですか。
そっちはもう終わったんですか？

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Oh! I've defeated the monsters perfectly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう！　
ばっちり魔物を倒してきたぜ。

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: I've become able to bark coolly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
オイラ、
かっこよく吠えられるようになったよ。

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: Is that true? It's probably nothing special anyway, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんとか～？　
どうせ大したことないんだろ？

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Here we go, watch closely. Suu~
text_block_list.orig_text:
いくよ、
見てて。
すぅ～～

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: GUOOOOOOH
text_block_list.orig_text: グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: This... is surprising.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これは……
驚いた。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: I thought it would be good if Victor could gain a little courage, but this is a pleasant miscalculation.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ビクターさんに少しでも度胸がつけばいいと思ってましたけど、
うれしい誤算です。

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: I've become pretty good at digging pitfalls, you know!
text_block_list.orig_text: オレだって落とし穴掘るのうまくなったんだぜ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure what you're saying, but...
text_block_list.orig_text: こちらは何言ってるのか分かりませんけど……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Eddie was also doing his best, you know!
text_block_list.orig_text: エディさんもちゃんとがんばってたッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Well, if everything ended safely, that's the most important thing. Since we've come this far, shall we all get rid of the people in the haunted house together?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ、
無事に終わったなら何よりです。
せっかくですし、
ここからはみんなで
肝試しの人を追い払っていきましょうか。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: That's right! We just had a taste of screams earlier!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ！　
ボクたちさっき
悲鳴を食べたんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: What!? I'm sliding!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なに！？　
ずりぃぞ！

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: If you want to eat, you better make sure to scare them properly, all of you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
食いたきゃ
おまえらもしっかり怖がらせるんだな！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: I-I'll do my best!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
が、
がんばる！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, the ghosts frightened numerous brave souls who dared to test their courage, and reveled in the sound of their screams.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その後、お化けたちは幾人もの肝試し客を脅かし、
悲鳴に舌鼓を打つのであった。

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
When I came to see how those humans are doing,
they're actually doing quite well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの人間どもの様子を見に来てみりゃあ、
なかなかにうまいことやってくれてるじゃねぇか。

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: When the existence of ghosts became known, I wondered what to do, but if it's like that, it seems there won't be any problems.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お化けの存在が知られたときはどうしたもんかと思ったが、
あの調子なら問題はなさそうだな。

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
If those pieces of junk can really do their job properly, 
Hehehe. They might actually be useful to me... 
I hope they continue to grow in that way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしも、
あのポンコツどもが本当にまともにやれるなら、
クククッ。
ちったぁ俺の役に立つかもな……
あの調子でどんどん成長してほしいもんだぜ。

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: However, watching them makes me hungry too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかし、
あいつら見てたら俺も腹が減ってきたな。

text_block_list.name: Punk 1
text_block_list.text: When I calm down and think about it, that girl earlier was just an ordinary girl, wasn't she! She scared me! Hey, come out! You will pay for embarrassing me, Miss Rei!
text_block_list.orig_text:
落ち着いて考えたら
さっきのは普通の女だったじゃねぇか！
ビビらせやがって！　
おい、
出てこい！
俺様に恥をさらさせた報いを受けやがれ！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: Oh, you've come at just the right time. Hehehe, you're an unlucky bastard. To meet me in a place where no one else is around.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっと、
ちょうどよく来やがった。
クククッ、
運のねぇ野郎だ。
誰もいないこんな場所で俺と出会っちまうなんてな。

text_block_list.name: Punk 1
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I can hear a voice from over there. 
Hey! Stop hiding and come out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
そっちから声が聞こえるな。
おい！　
隠れてねぇで出てきやがれ！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: Look, I came out for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
出てきてやったぞ。

text_block_list.name: Punk 1
text_block_list.text: Oh, wha-what is this!? Gyaahhhhh!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわっ、
な、
なんだ！？　
ギャ～～～～～！？

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. 
I don't like being just a scream, it's too weak. 
I'll take everything from you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わりぃな。
俺は悲鳴だけなんてなまっちょろいのは嫌いでね。
根こそぎ頂いてくぜ。

text_block_list.name: Punk 1
text_block_list.text: U-uh... Uuu... Uuuuuu...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うぅ……
うぅぅうぅう……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
In the desolate graveyard, 
only the man's groans echoed eerily.
text_block_list.orig_text:
人けのない墓場に、
男のうめき声だけが不気味に響き渡るのであった。
